title: A user_action_v2 naming another session never executes

rejection.rule: An action message naming another session produces unexpected_message; it never executes. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §7, §11)
rejection.effect: The phone's own send is a conformance violation; the desktop returns protocol_error_v2 unexpected_message. The current session's coaching state is unchanged.

summary: The phone sends a user_action_v2 whose sessionId differs from the accepted connection session. The action MUST NOT execute; the desktop treats it as an unexpected message.
